name: Surf
description: Web app where an OpenAI computer-use model operates a cloud Linux desktop in an E2B sandbox while you watch and chat.
whatItDoes: Lets a user type instructions and see an AI operate a virtual desktop live in the browser. It is a reference application for developers building computer-use products on sandboxed machines.
howItWorks: A Next.js front end starts an E2B desktop sandbox and streams its screen. The server forwards screenshots to the computer-use model, applies the returned mouse and keyboard actions inside the sandbox, and streams progress back to the page as server-sent events.
